question: Select the correct combination of Indian classical dance and their respective dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Anita Ratnam – Bharatanatyam__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anita Ratnam** is a renowned **Indian classical dancer and choreographer**.
 
• She is known for her expertise in **Bharatnatyam**, a classical dance form of India.
 
• Ratlam has performed at numerous national and international dance festivals and events.
 
• She is the **founder-director** of **Arangham Trust**, set up in **Chennai** in **1992**.
 
• She has received several awards and accolades for her contribution to the field of dance, some of the awards are **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (2016)**, **Media Achievement Award (1991), Natya Ratna (2017)**.
